semantic_checks: Player.Religion20 is distinct from Game.Religion and City.Religion
Religion and both nested records require version20; PlotCoord is unversioned signed x/y
four b-prefixed Religion fields are proven FAutoVariable<int>, not bool
BeliefYield and Yield are raw signed enum ordinals; Belief/District/Tech/GreatPersonIndividual/promotion-class values are definition hashes
signed Q8 words preserve all bits
Resources16 ownership arrays contain counted signed vectors rather than assumed reset-default triples
CityResource is an unversioned u32 CityID/Resource definition hash pair
accumulated IndexList wrapper has no nested version
resource arrays preserve order and duplicate/unknown hashes
negative reserved counts are preserved in wire transport; native reader clamp is not emulated

Religion checks each vector typed allocation against max_bytes; Resources checks addressable layout without a typed byte-policy cap; both bound aggregate consumed wire bytes/items and preflight available input before reserve
saved_is_alive_scope: unchanged saved first header flag; runtime configuration/GameDipRel/player validity remain external authority

peer_codec_review.tracked_depth_policy: 0 through64, localization separately64; not native maximum
